title: Biomedical Imaging Modalities
description: Principles of biomedical imaging modalities with emphasis on ultrasound, x-ray, computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The theory of wave propagation, impedance matching, wave-particle duality, quantum physics and nuclear magnetic resonance for medical imaging.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 402, BME 402.
